title: Attunement
summary: Magic items that require attunement are marked, and characters can attune to them from the item's ⋯ menu, up to 3 items each unless the DM sets another limit.
items: Open5e magic items carry their attunement requirement when added as loot or bought; the DM can mark any other item in Edit item.
Players attune their own characters; at the limit the DM can still attune past it, and the activity says so.
Giving, selling or using up an attuned item ends the attunement, and whoever receives it isn't attuned.
The character sheet shows Attuned 2/3, and the DM sets each character's limit (0 to 10) there.
